title: React Compiler Analyzer configuration
description: Configuration for react-compiler-analyzer. Command-line options override values from this file.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON schema for editor IntelliSense.

mode.description: React Compiler compilation mode used by both commands.

verbose.description: Show per-function compiler events in the output.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of files processed in parallel.

exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded when scanning directories.

format.description: Report output format used by both commands.

strictPaths.description: Fail instead of warning when a scan path does not exist.

analyze.description: Stable settings specific to the analyze command.

quote.description: Quote style for directives written by --annotate.

risks.description: Opt-in detection for known React Compiler runtime risks.

storeAccessorPattern.description: Regex source matching non-hook store-accessor names such as getAppStore.

selectorHookProperties.description: Property names identifying hidden selector hooks, such as use in store.use.field().

resolveWrappers.description: Follow first-party wrapper calls and re-export barrels to risky leaves. Applies only when a leaf rule is configured.

resolver.description: Opt-in package conditions and ordered entry fields; tsconfig aliases are discovered per importing file.

additionalConditionNames.description: Conditions added to import/node/default. Package export key order still determines matching precedence.

mainFields.description: Ordered replacement for module/main. Exports/imports restrictions take precedence.
